items.title: Replace all koala/Koala/KOALA with lattice/Lattice/LATTICE in CHANGELOG.md
items.context: Full de-koala of CHANGELOG.md: version titles (Koala 0.3.x -> Lattice 0.3.x), product-name prose (Koala -> Lattice), koala-lab -> lattice-lab, and ALL historical technical tokens (@koala-agent -> @lattice-agent, koala commands -> lattice, .koala/ -> .lattice/, bin/koala.js -> bin/lattice.js, koala.config -> lattice.config). Case-preserving substitution. User accepts the history becomes non-literal. Scope is CHANGELOG.md only.
items.userSees: git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md returns 0 (down from 49); CHANGELOG reads fully Lattice-branded

items.title: Acceptance: zero koala in CHANGELOG, build and validate green
items.context: git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md returns nothing; npm run build exits 0; the lattice validate suite stays all-green (CHANGELOG is docs, excluded from the koala-residue gate, no test impact).
